exact_statement: For every uniform Boolean sign f whose occupied Fourier labels project injectively under deletion of A, every physical assignment on A preserves the complete squared-mass multiset and H(f), and leaves influence I(f)-sum_{i in A}Inf_i(f). Thus support minimum distance L gives an all-branch adaptive entropy plateau through depth L-1. For every Boolean seed g and L>=2, F_L(x)=g(product_{j=1}^L x_1j,...,product_{j=1}^L x_nj) has H(F_L)=H(g), I(F_L)=L I(g); its physical block-compression partition has Pi_H=0, Pi_I=(L-1)I(g), every terminal H=H(g), I=I(g), and ratio amplification L if H(g)>0. For nonconstant g and L>=d+2, every restriction of depth <=d is nonunate and therefore not C001-regular. For G_r,m=(1-2 indicator_{x=all+}) product_{j=1}^m z_j, r>=2,m>=1, all spectator prefixes preserve H, I=root core influence+m-k, and terminal/root ratio amplification equals 1+m 2^(r-1)/r, unbounded already for m=1. The core H/I tends to 4, so no FEI disproof follows. On any injective d-coordinate restriction with positive entropy and balanced residual, amplification is at most d+1.
